query: My TechCorp Nexa Fold X1 screen flickers and goes blank whenever I open it, so I can't see anything or access the settings, which stops me from using the phone.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Screen Flicker Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Screen flicker fix

actions.description: It will get the hardware checked

steps: If your device has sustained any damage, visit a TechCorp walk-in service center.
Alternatively, schedule a repair service online.
Increase the lighting in your scene.
Adjust shutter speed in Pro Video mode.
Try adjusting the shutter speed to a slower setting until the flickering disappears.
